model.name: Store-once theme-only names — a stored name may not embed a DERIVED field (sprint number), enforced by construction
model.description: A unit stores the THEME ONLY; the sprint NUMBER (and any other DERIVED field) is DERIVED, never embedded in the stored name — model.number carries the number, so a stored 'Sprint N:' prefix guarantees double-numbering anywhere the number is re-added (the S34 double-title, planner S01-S09, and now S37 b86b53cc are the SAME embedded-number drift class). A lint/guard REFUSES (RED) a stored name that embeds its own sprint number or any derived field, folded into ci:gates with a STUB-MUST-FAIL bite, PLUS a one-time sweep that repairs existing embedded-number names across sprint units. Three manual repairs (notice-dirt -> restore-HEAD -> regen-de-double) means we are treating a generator's output instead of KILLING the generator — by-construction, a stored 'Sprint 37:' prefix becomes IMPOSSIBLE rather than merely restorable (same shape as the -a1b2 collision-generator retirement: kill the source, don't guard the output).

discoverySource.note: The embedded-number drift CLASS: a stored name echoes a field that is DERIVED elsewhere (sprint number = model.number), so re-adding the number double-numbers. Manual repair performed 3x = kill-the-generator, per doctrine. Attribution of each dirtying = UNKNOWN (worktree-only edits, no git record) — the GUARD makes the culprit irrelevant.

model.crossRefNote: Naming/store-once canon family: R37.13 check-altid-canon (no bespoke C-scheme on Task name+slug/Req altId) + R37.14 fabricated-identifier (no fabricated/parent-prefix uuids) + R37.15 store-once-theme-only (no derived-field embedded in a stored name). Distinct-intent each (distinct defect, distinct Test) — NOT folded (no over-crediting). The guard MAY extend AltIdCanonGuard 13f97053 OR be a new StoreOnceGuard — architect's chain call.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A unit's stored name contains ONLY the theme, never a DERIVED field: a name embedding its own sprint number (e.g. a 'Sprint N:' prefix that model.number already carries) or any other derived/echoed field is FORBIDDEN. Store-once: a value derived elsewhere is never duplicated in free-text where it can drift.
A lint/guard REFUSES (RED) a stored name that embeds its own sprint number or any derived field, folded into ci:gates — double-numbering becomes IMPOSSIBLE by construction, not merely restorable.

The guard is PROVEN non-vacuous by a STUB-MUST-FAIL bite: plant a 'Sprint 37:'-prefixed sprint name -> RED naming it; a clean theme-only name -> GREEN; weaken/remove the guard -> the bite suite goes RED (meta-bite).

A one-time SWEEP detects + repairs existing embedded-number names across ALL sprint units (the 3 known: S34, S01-S09 legacy, S37 b86b53cc + any others found), restoring each to theme-only. Idempotent, dry-run + count reported FIRST, verify-owner-first per unit (name field ONLY, never the number/derived source).

BY-CONSTRUCTION: after the guard the embedded-number drift class CANNOT recur — the 3rd manual repair is the last. Per the -a1b2 precedent (kill the collision generator, not guard its output) and the fleet doctrine that a 3x-repaired defect is a missing guard, not bad luck.
